notes: The parts are the same as in step 1. Nothing was added or dropped.
The circuit images did not render, so the layout follows the text: six LEDs, each with a 220 ohm resistor in series, on pins 2-7, with the LED cathodes to ground.

Each channel runs from a Uno pin through a jumper wire to a breadboard column. The resistor spans the centre gap in that column. The LED anode goes in the same bottom-half column, and the LED cathode goes to the bottom ground rail (bn).
The resistor is on the anode side of each LED.
The ground wire runs from Uno GND.1 to the bn rail. GND.1 is an assumption.
Breadboard columns 3, 6, 9, 12, 15 and 18 are my own placement. The tutorial does not specify them.
